comment: Tests that fail on main for a recorded reason. test:touched excludes them from the pre-commit related-test gate and prints each exclusion. Remove an entry in the same commit that makes the test pass.

tests.reason: 3 pins fail against the current parent GLB (re-measured 2026-10-07 on a fresh fixed-capture recount with the current asset, rhubarb cues unchanged): dy bias 5.16px (gate 3) and max 9.41px (gate 5) persist on current pixels, so the offset is systematic visibility composition on the rebuilt lower arch (3a1e49634 reseat plus FF chain through d33b3d2b7), not stale ground truth — needs a solver-side projection fix, not a pin tweak; jaw travel 9.31mm vs <=8.6 (growth net of the ac2a84ac2 rest-drop/down-gain, measured 8.88 in-commit, plus the undocumented FF-chain remainder — no stated new baseline, re-pinning would be widening); pitch probe blocked on the dy gate (instrument response itself healthy: 2-degree dose shifts bias 3.44px). Rim band re-pinned 6.0+-0.7 in the same slice (series 5.318-6.680mm, 3a1e49634 reseat) and green.
